card.name: Rio+20 Sustainable Development conference text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, the, in, an opening parenthesis) inside one web article about the 1992 and 2012 UN Conferences on Sustainable Development in Rio.

modes.label: Punctuation after conference name
modes.description: Opening parenthesis or space right after the conference title, before the acronym or year.
modes.example: Twenty years after the first United Nations Conference on Sustainable Development<< (>>UNCSD) that took place in Rio

modes.label: Linking words before the conference
modes.description: Words like of, the, in that lead into a mention of the UN conference or the sustainable development framework.
modes.example: This report later became the basis for the negotiations<< of>> the UN Conference on Sustainable Development

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in one article about the Rio Earth Summit and Rio+20, not on medical content.
